items.quote: Except the God of my father, the God of Abraham, and the fear of Isaac, had been with me, surely thou hadst sent me away now empty.
items.claim: Jacob asserts that God's presence protected him from being sent away destitute by Laban
items.actor: God of my father, God of Abraham, fear of Isaac

items.quote: God hath seen mine affliction and the labour of my hands, and rebuked thee yesternight.
items.claim: God witnessed Jacob's suffering and labor, and rebuked Laban during the previous night
items.object: affliction and labour of my hands, thee
